sentences.text: 2. By the order dated 15.07.2024, it was recorded that the prosecutrix was duly served, however, she had chosen not to appear, and in this regard, the I.O. had also recorded her statement.
Considering that the appeal pertains to an offence punishable under Section 376 IPC, Ms. Aarzoo Aneja, Advocate (Mob. No. 9540129000) is appointed as an Amicus Curiae to represent her.
The I.O. shall supply a complete copy of paper book to the learned Amicus so appointed.
4. Let the I.O. inform the complainant about the next date of hearing.
